title: Migrate skills/share-with to Agent Plugins v1.0.0 package using skills-to-plugins
description: Use the skills-to-plugins workflow from https://github.com/ghchinoy/agent-skills (plugins/agent-plugin-authoring/skills/skills-to-plugins) to convert the flat skills/share-with/SKILL.md into a spec-conformant Agent Plugins v1.0.0 package under plugins/share-with/ (plugins/share-with/plugin.json, plugins/share-with/skills/share-with/SKILL.md, and .claude-plugin/marketplace.json). Run audit-conformance.sh and validate-plugins.sh to confirm 0 conformance errors, and update README.md and AGENTS.md paths.
acceptance_criteria: Passes skills-to-plugins audit-conformance.sh and validate-plugins.sh with 0 errors; includes valid plugin.json and .claude-plugin/marketplace.json manifests; preserves git history via git mv.
close_reason: Migrated to Agent Plugins v1.0.0 under plugins/share-with/ with .claude-plugin/marketplace.json; passed audit-conformance.sh and validate-plugins.sh with 0 errors

title: Audit and enforce portable GitHub skill URLs instead of fixed local paths across docs
description: Ensure any referenced external agent skills or plugins in AGENTS.md, GEMINI.md, README.md, and plugin/skill docs reference their canonical GitHub repository URL (https://github.com/ghchinoy/agent-skills) rather than fixed workstation filesystem paths, and add a Make/CI lint check guarding against machine-local path regressions.
acceptance_criteria: Zero machine-local filesystem paths in tracked Markdown, manifests, or CI files; all external skill references point to https://github.com/ghchinoy/agent-skills.
close_reason: Replaced local paths with https://github.com/ghchinoy/agent-skills URLs and enforced automated checks in scripts/validate-plugin.sh and repo_hygiene_test.go

title: Add automated cross-platform binary release workflow (release-please + GoReleaser) and document in AGENTS.md
description: Configure automated semantic releases using release-please (.github/workflows/release-please.yml, release-please-config.json, .release-please-manifest.json) paired with GoReleaser (.goreleaser.yaml) to build reproducible (-trimpath) cross-platform binaries, archives, and SHA-256 checksums for darwin, linux, and windows (amd64 and arm64). Document the end-to-end release process in AGENTS.md and README.md.
acceptance_criteria: Includes release-please GitHub Actions workflow and .goreleaser.yaml passing goreleaser check; injects version ldflags with -trimpath; documents release process in AGENTS.md and README.md.
close_reason: Added release-please + GoReleaser v2 cross-platform workflow (.github/workflows/release.yml, .github/workflows/ci.yml, .goreleaser.yaml, release-please-config.json), ldflags version wiring (cmd/version.go), and release process docs in AGENTS.md and README.md

title: Add 'share-with links <doc>' subcommand to extract and classify embedded hyperlinks
description: Export a Google Doc as text/html via Drive Files.Export (preserving table-cell hyperlinks and smart chips that plain-text exports drop), unwrap www.google.com/url?q= redirects, and extract deduplicated targets classified into google_drive (with file_id and resourcekey), colab, golink, cl, mailto, and web.
acceptance_criteria: Supports 'share-with links <doc-or-id>' under GroupID 'inspection' with --drive-only, --limit, and --json; propagates X-Goog-Drive-Resource-Keys; covered by offline http.RoundTripper unit tests.

title: Add 'share-with audit <doc> [emails...]' packet reader audit subcommand
description: Given a parent packet Google Doc and a target reviewer roster (supporting @user, user@, and user shorthands), audit explicit and domain-level permissions across the parent doc and all linked Drive/Docs/Sheets/Slides/Colab artifacts (--recursive-links). Classify items into covered, missing_restricted (Tier 1: canShare=true and no domain link-sharing), missing_domain_shared (Tier 2: domain link-shared but missing explicit ACLs), and unshareable (canShare=false / HTTP 403). Flag linked Drive titles carrying '[deprecated]' prefixes.
acceptance_criteria: Supports 'share-with audit <doc> [emails...]' with --recursive-links, --role (default reader), --limit, and --json; emits alignment-safe semantic matrix and copy-pasteable remediation hints.

title: Create Astro + Starlight documentation and landing ./site styled after elephant-goldfish-model
description: Build a static Astro + Starlight site under ./site modeled on the typography, color-scheme tokens, and layout styling of https://github.com/google/elephant-goldfish-model/tree/main/site (self-hosted Google Sans Flex and Google Sans Code fonts, light-dark() CSS custom properties, starlight-llms-txt, zero external Google Fonts runtime calls, and GitHub Pages deployment workflow). Cover quickstart, silent-sharing safety architecture, plugin installation, binary release installation, CLI reference, and ADC troubleshooting.
acceptance_criteria: astro check and astro build pass under ./site with static output, light/dark theme parity, starlight-llms-txt generation, zero external font requests, and GitHub Pages deploy workflow.
close_reason: Created Astro + Starlight ./site styled after elephant-goldfish-model with self-hosted Google Sans Flex & Google Sans Code fonts, Agent Plugin & Skill guide, starlight-llms-txt, and GitHub Pages workflow; verified with astro check and astro build

title: Support optional silent permission expiration (--expires / --ttl) for time-bounded reviews
description: Expose optional '--expires <RFC3339>' and '--ttl <duration>' (e.g. 90d) flags on 'share-with' and 'share-with grant' setting Drive v3 Permission.ExpirationTime on silent user/group grants so review-packet access (role alignment, promo, security review) auto-expires after the review cycle.
acceptance_criteria: Validates future timestamp <= 365 days per Drive API v3 rules, rejects mutually exclusive --expires/--ttl flags, preserves sendNotificationEmail=false, and surfaces expiration_time in grant and list --json outputs.

title: Support batch and packet-linked silent grants (--targets-file and --from-doc-links)
description: Allow 'share-with grant' to silently share multiple Drive targets in one invocation via '--targets-file <path>' or '--from-doc-links <packet-doc>' ('--tier restricted|all'). Gracefully skip canShare=false targets while enforcing SilentGuardTransport (sendNotificationEmail=false) and the pre-grant no-downgrade guard (already_shared).
acceptance_criteria: Supports --dry-run and --json multi-document reports; never sends notifications; never downgrades existing owner/editor/commenter roles.

title: Surface and deduplicate unresolved go/ shortlinks during 'links' and 'audit'
description: Packet documents often include go/ or goto.google.com shortlinks either alongside a direct docs.google.com link in the same table cell or standalone. Detect standalone go/ links that lack a companion Drive URL in the same paragraph/cell and surface them in a dedicated audit warning section so hidden Drive artifacts behind shortlinks are not overlooked.
acceptance_criteria: Distinctly reports standalone vs paired go/ shortlinks in 'links' and 'audit' human and --json outputs.
